goal: Independently derive the ISO-8601 week-date form of each of the 10 dates in inputs/dates.json using the ordinal-date (day-of-year) formula method only, from the governed inputs alone.

nodes.instructions: For each of the 10 dates in inputs/dates.json, compute the ISO-8601 week-date YYYY-Www-D using exclusively the ordinal-date formula method specified in the prompt (week = floor((ordinal - weekday + 10) / 7) with the week-0 and week-53 boundary rules), and write child-answers.json containing every answer and the method statement. Do not use nearest-Thursday / Thursday-of-week reasoning in any step. Emit the deliverable under a propose ledger event at authoring time.
